scope: Scoped rendered UI only: actual compiled Chromium synthetic UI. No authenticated hosted, physical tablet, backend, real media, security or functional certification.

authority.human_eye: Final Visual Inspection Blind Protocol V2.0, effective 2026-09-29; current Notion page fetched directly

SOURCE_IDENTITY.binding_basis: supplied neutral manifests; all 27 referenced file hashes independently recomputed and matched; no source implementation read

CoverageReceipt.REGION_COVERAGE: 51/51: five document regions in each raster plus active dialog region in six modal states

READABLE_VIEWS.method: All 18 PNGs opened using view_image and emitted to reviewer; 54 small-asset positions at 4x source pixels plus large avatar shapes at native readable scale.

EDGE_GATES.method: Explicit per-asset LEFT/RIGHT/TOP/BOTTOM pixel resolutions below. All neutral container checks are true; intentional modal occlusion resolved separately, never inferred as artwork clipping.

CoverageReceipt.APPLICATION_BINDING: WatchNest private family approved-video library; parent/child shared-device profile picker, Eli PIN handoff, wrong-PIN states. 390x844 / 768x1024 / 1024x768 CSS viewports. Full-document PNGs are respectively 390x942 / 768x1039 / 1024x775; below-viewport document regions are not asserted simultaneously visible. All dialogs fit their viewport.

HUMAN_GATES.alignment: PASS: brand anchor and card grid align consistently; modal is centered in viewport, independently of taller document.
HUMAN_GATES.optical_centering: PASS: avatars and identity artwork sit comfortably within circular carriers; modal rocket balances title.
HUMAN_GATES.spacing_rhythm: PASS: generous card rhythm, consistent internal gaps, and clear separation before Parent Mode.
HUMAN_GATES.grouping: PASS: names, library action, and handoff/current status form one clear profile group; dialog PIN and error are grouped.
HUMAN_GATES.hierarchy: PASS: screen title, profile identities, and active parent PIN dialog have distinct priorities; scrim intentionally suppresses background.
HUMAN_GATES.crop_story: PASS: avatars, brand mark, locks, and footer icon have intact visible contours; modal-hidden artwork is intentionally occluded. No photo or media content evaluated.
HUMAN_GATES.contrast: PASS: readable foreground copy, lavender iconwork, white identities, and peach PIN/error emphasis. Dim background is intentional modal treatment.
HUMAN_GATES.gestalt: PASS: calm premium ink/lavender/peach system remains coherent at all three sizes.
HUMAN_GATES.identity_clarity: PASS: four distinct profile symbols and names, explicit Selected profile versus Parent handoff, and Eli identity repeated in dialog.
HUMAN_GATES.touch_targets: PASS for supplied geometry: profile cards minimum 169x243.1875, Parent Mode 174x52, PIN minimum 286x66, Cancel minimum 286x48 CSS px. No real-device behavior claim.
HUMAN_GATES.error_presentation: PASS: wrong PIN copy is legible, contained, and adjacent to PIN without displacing controls outside viewport.

CoverageReceipt.FINAL_RESULT: CLEAN / PASS for supplied rendered UI scope
